title: Principal Consultant - Aquatic Design
description:
WSP is seeking an exceptional Principal Consultant to lead and grow our Aquatic \& Wellness design discipline from our Global Capability Centre (GCC). This is a uniquely integrated role that combines senior design leadership with full technical project delivery and is central to our strategic ambition of building an independently capable, India\-based delivery team.  



  

In this role, you will drive the complete lifecycle of aquatic and wellness projects — from early pre\-concept and concept design through schematic design, technical production, and final delivery. You will bring both a strong design sensibility and engineering rigour, leading visual narratives, 3D models, and design documentation while simultaneously owning project delivery, quality assurance, and team performance.  



  

This position is pivotal to WSP’s long\-term goal of enabling the India GCC to operate as a fully self\-sufficient delivery hub for Aquatic \& Wellness projects globally. You will play a founding role in building that capability, including mentoring junior team members, establishing robust workflows, and working progressively toward independent end\-to\-end project ownership from India. You will exercise independent judgment on complex and ambiguous technical matters, manage multidisciplinary collaboration across geographies, and serve as the discipline’s senior representative.


  
BIM LEADERSHIP
  

* Lead the design process across all phases: from pre\-concept, concept, and schematic stages through to technical design and delivery, ensuring a clear, consistent design direction throughout.
* Develop and lead design narratives, articulating design intent through presentations, documentation, and client\-facing materials.
* Create and direct visuals including mood boards, user journeys, diagrams, spatial compositions, and 3D models that evolve alongside project needs.
* Lead the preparation of complete concept design packages in alignment with WSP standards and client expectations.
* Apply a strong eye for detail, colour, materials, and spatial composition to ensure experiential quality across all design outputs.
* Contribute meaningfully to later design stages by developing and refining plans, sections, and critical architectural details in CAD, Revit, and BIM workflows.
TECHNICAL DESIGN DELIVERY
  

* Take full ownership of aquatic and wellness design projects, applying deep technical knowledge across swimming pool, water feature, and spa/wellness systems.
* Actively participate in the production, review, and approval of design documentation, drawings, and models, maintaining a strong focus on quality, constructability, and sustainability.
* Lead the analysis and resolution of complex, multi\-variable technical challenges, exercising independent professional judgement on the optimal course of action.
* Uphold QA/QC processes throughout the full design lifecycle, including direct contribution to technical outputs where required.
* Ensure technical outputs meet relevant international and local codes, standards, and industry best practices.
PRODUCTION \& DIGITAL DELIVERY
  

* Lead the development of 2D and 3D models from early concept stages through to detailed architectural documentation.
* Develop digital massing models, visualisations, and diagrams for client presentations and internal reviews.
* Manage and enforce organised model structures, layer conventions, and naming standards to support efficient team collaboration.
* Prepare well\-structured drawing packages across concept, schematic, and downstream documentation phases.
* Lead the assembly of comprehensive design documentation — plans, sections, elevations, renders, and diagrams — ensuring graphic quality reflects design intent at every stage.
* Ensure all digital deliverables comply with WSP’s internal delivery standards, templates, and naming conventions.
PROJECT COORDINATION \& STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT
  

* Manage technical resources, workflows, and project timelines to ensure efficient and on\-time delivery.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (architecture, engineering, MEP, planning, and specialty consultants) across geographies to integrate technical and design requirements.
* Interface with clients and stakeholders, providing technical input and addressing project requirements with confidence and clarity.
* Represent the discipline in meetings, workshops, and presentations, resolving technical queries and communicating design decisions effectively.
* Coordinate with WSP’s global Aquatic \& Wellness teams to ensure the India GCC contributes to, and progressively leads, project delivery

TEAM LEADERSHIP \& MENTORING
  

* Supervise and mentor junior designers, BIM technicians, and production staff, supporting their professional development and alignment with WSP standards.
* Operate with significant autonomy and minimal supervision, setting the objectives, pace, and working approach for the India Aquatic \& Wellness team.
* Lead teams in developing new methods, techniques, and analytical frameworks to address significant technical and operational challenges.
* Contribute to resource planning, workload forecasting, and the development of internal processes and delivery procedures.
* Support the Head of Discipline in establishing and continuously enhancing operational excellence.
PROCESS DEVELOPMENT \& INNOVATION
  

* Lead initiatives to enhance design workflows, digital delivery processes, and documentation standards across the team.
* Develop internal design templates, libraries, and graphic assets to ensure consistent, high\-quality project output.
* Explore and champion new tools, techniques, and digital methods, including AIassisted visualisation, parametric modelling, and BIM workflows, to advance design and delivery capability.
* Document and share lessons learned and best practices, supporting continuous improvement within the India team.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, creative curiosity, and continuous innovation.
STRATEGIC GOAL: INDEPENDENT INDIA\-BASED DELIVERY
  

This is the defining objective of this role. The Principal Consultant will be the cornerstone of WSP’s ambition to establish the India GCC as a world\-class, fully self\-sufficient delivery centre for Aquatic \& Wellness design.
  

* Progressively take ownership of full project delivery, from client brief and concept through to construction documentation, managed and delivered entirely from India.
* Establish the workflows, quality frameworks, and team capabilities necessary for end\-to\-end independent delivery.
* Build, develop, and retain a high\-performing India\-based design and technical team capable of handling complex international projects.
* Collaborate with the Head of Aquatic Design to define milestones and a roadmap for transitioning projects to full India\-led delivery.
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for project delivery quality, efficiency, and client satisfaction from the India GCC.
* Act as an ambassador for the India team’s capability, building trust with global stakeholders and demonstrating that world\-class aquatic design can be delivered from India.

  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum 12–15\+ years of progressive experience in the design and delivery of aquatic and wellness projects, including swimming pools, water features, and spa environments.
* Demonstrated experience spanning both design (concept, schematic, design development) and technical delivery (documentation, coordination, QA/QC, construction support).
* Prior experience in a consulting or design\-build environment, ideally with exposure to international projects and multidisciplinary teams.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
  

* Advanced proficiency in 2D/3D design software including AutoCAD, Revit, Rhino, Grasshopper, or similar platforms.
* Proficiency in BIM workflows and collaboration tools such as BIM360\.
* High proficiency in graphic presentation tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator).
* Exceptional visualisation and representation abilities including diagrams, sketches, and digital modelling.
* Strong understanding of relevant international and local design codes, standards, and best practices for aquatic and wellness environments.
LEADERSHIP \& INTERPERSONAL SKILLS
  

* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor teams, with experience managing geographically distributed or multidisciplinary groups.
* Confident presenter and communicator, able to articulate complex design and technical ideas clearly to clients, stakeholders, and internal teams.
* Strong coordination and integration skills across architecture, engineering, MEP, and specialist disciplines.
* Ability to operate with significant autonomy, exercising sound judgement on complex and ambiguous matters.
* Curiosity and drive to explore emerging tools, techniques, and digital methods (e.g., AI\-assisted design, parametric workflows).
* Passion for design excellence, continuous improvement, and building highperforming teams.
* Professional licensure (e.g., CEng, P.Eng) is preferred but not essential.

BGV:


• Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third\-party agency appointed by WSP India.


• Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Systems Engineering Advisor - Endpoint Management-Patch/Deployment/SCCM Analyst
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering Advisor \- Endpoint Management\-Patch/Deployment/SCCM Analyst to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
  
  

ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking an experienced SCCM/Intune Lead Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This lead\-level role combines deep technical expertise with delivery ownership — driving complex SCCM/Intune engagements, leading technical teams, architecting enterprise endpoint solutions, and serving as a key client\-facing technical authority for EPM workstreams from India. The Lead Engineer plays a critical role in NTT DATA's EPM service delivery quality, client satisfaction, and practice capability growth, supporting global accounts across the US, Europe, and APAC.
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Technical Leadership Architecture
  
* Lead end\-to\-end design and implementation of enterprise SCCM/ConfigMgr and Microsoft Intune environments for global client accounts.
* Architect co\-management strategies, Autopilot provisioning frameworks, and Modern Management transition roadmaps.
* Own the technical direction for SCCM\-to\-Intune migration engagements including workload transition planning, timeline development, and risk mitigation.
* Define EPM platform standards, governance frameworks, and configuration baselines across multiple global accounts managed from India.
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Manager capabilities and provide technical roadmap recommendations to delivery managers and clients.


Enterprise Patch Management
  
* Own enterprise\-level patch management programs — governing policy, SLAs, exception management, and compliance reporting across 10,000\+ endpoint fleets.
* Design and manage Intune Expedite policies, WUfB rings, and SCCM ADR\-based patching for complex multi\-site global environments.
* Lead vulnerability remediation programs integrating Qualys/Tenable findings with SCCM/Intune patch deployment cycles.
* Develop patching governance documentation, escalation playbooks, and compliance dashboards for client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead emergency and zero\-day patching response including containment, deployment, and post\-incident review from India delivery centre.


Advanced OS Deployment Provisioning
  
* Lead enterprise Windows 11 migration programs including readiness assessment, task sequence design, pilot execution, and phased rollout.
* Design and deliver Windows Autopilot \+ Intune Zero Touch Provisioning frameworks for large\-scale global device refresh programs.
* Own OSD platform operations — WinPE environments, MDT integration, driver library management, and image currency.
* Architect golden image build pipelines, compliance validation, and automated post\-deployment configuration.
* Define device lifecycle management policies from procurement through decommission for managed global client environments.


Automation Integration
  
* Architect PowerShell\-based automation frameworks for SCCM and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
* Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy enforcement, and reporting.
* Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client\-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.
* Oversee integration between EPM platforms and security tooling (Qualys, Defender for Endpoint) for holistic endpoint health management.


Client Engagement Delivery Governance
  
* Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned EPM accounts — leading governance calls, delivery reviews, and escalation resolution from India.
* Drive SLA attainment, delivery quality, and continuous improvement across managed global endpoint accounts.
* Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.
* Mentor and develop Grade 7–9 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and structured capability building.
* Collaborate with NTT DATA India practice leadership and onshore counterparts on EPM service development and client strategies.


REQUIRED SKILLS
  
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — site architecture, hierarchy design, OSD, patch management, reporting (expert)
* Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co\-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)
* Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
* Azure AD / Entra ID — identity\-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
* PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
* SQL Server \+ Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management\-level visualizations
* Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle
* Client\-facing delivery governance from India — SLA management, delivery reviews, escalation ownership

* Message Tracking Analytics: Track message dispositions, investigate delivery failures, and generate executive reports on threat trends using centralized management dashboards
* Quarantine Management: Review, release, or delete quarantined emails, and address false positives to prevent business disruption
* Monitor Sender Ecosystem: Regularly review Valimail Monitor or Enforce reports to identify and track all third\-party services sending emails on your domain's behalf
* Monitoring Visibility: Review the Valimail Monitor dashboard to identify unapproved third\-party services and unauthorized IP addresses
* Monitor system performance, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions for email security incidents.
* Manage configuration, upgrades, and patching for Cisco Secure Email and Valimail environments.
* Collaborate with IT security, compliance, and infrastructure teams to maintain optimal email security posture.

* Plan and Coordinate with the vendor for regular health checks and implement vendor recommendations
* Provides deep subject matter expertise, advice and program delivery.
* Support 24x7 steady state operations\-Flexible working in US business hours for all required work done and during weekends.
* Performs root cause analysis on failed components and implements corrective measures.
* Candidates must have exceptional customer service, problem solving, and communication skills
* Possess the ability to work independently with minimal management supervision and with a global team of engineers

* Proficiency in email protocols (SMTP, IMAP, POP3\) and email authentication standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).

title: Lead Product Engineer
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Cadence is a pivotal leader in electronic design, building upon more than 30 years of computational software expertise. The company applies its underlying Intelligent System Design strategy to deliver software, hardware and IP that turn design concepts into reality. Cadence customers are the world’s most innovative companies, delivering extraordinary electronic products from chips to boards to systems for the most dynamic market applications including consumer, hyperscale computing, 5G communications, automotive, aerospace industrial and health.**

**The Cadence Advantage**

* **The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge technology in an environment that encourages you to be creative, innovative, and to make an impact.**
* **Cadence’s employee\-friendly policies focus on the physical and mental well\-being of employees, career development, providing opportunities for learning, and celebrating success in recognition of specific needs of the employees.**
* **The unique “One Cadence – One Team” culture promotes collaboration within and across teams to ensure customer success**
* **Multiple avenues of learning and development available for employees to explore as per their specific requirement and interests**
* **You get to work with a diverse team of passionate, dedicated, and talented individuals who go above and beyond for our customers, our communities, and each other—every day.**

**Job Description Summary:**


This is a position in the Hardware Emulation Product Engineering team in the Verification Business Unit. The candidate is expected to have hands\-on experience in Design or Verification using Verilog/ SystemVerilog. Emulation experience is a key requirement for this position.

**Job Description**


The role requires analyzing customer requirements for best emulation performance and working with multiple teams within the organization to enable that. The role requires gathering, analyzing, and publishing key performance metrics, enabling data\-driven decisions for current and future product enhancements. At scale. The objective is to enable higher customer productivity and as a result, higher customer satisfaction.


You will investigate customer\-reported challenges, identify performance bottlenecks, analyze trends over time, and conduct targeted experiments to improve compile and runtime performance across complex SoC verification environments. You will also create technical collateral for product features and flows. You will apply empirical analysis, modeling, testing, and benchmarking methodologies to validate product specifications and measure the effectiveness of product flows and performance improvements. Collaboration will span Product Engineering, R\&D, Product Validation and Customer Success teams to drive solutions from concept through deployment.

**Desired Qualifications \& Skills**

* BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
* Strong understanding of SystemVerilog, RTL design, and verification methodologies with competence in Emulation or FPGA Prototyping
* Ability to analyze customer use cases and translate requirements into product and performance improvements
* Experience of performance characterization, benchmarking, profiling, and root\-cause analysis techniques
* Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) processes
* Excellent analytical, debugging, problem\-solving, written, and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work effectively across globally distributed cross\-functional teams
* Leverage AI tools for improving efficiency and effectiveness

**Educational Experience:**


Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electronics or Electrical Engineering \+ 4 years of related experience, or Masters \+ 2 year of related experience
